newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Aussie Home Loans sees further rate cut.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Aussie Home Loans sees further rate cut.

text.p: Mortgage originator Aussie Home Loans said on Friday it believed another interest rate cut was likely within the next three months.
Managing director John Symond said inflation in Australia remained low, while the economy was sluggish and signs of recovery patchy.
"I think there is better than a 50 or 60 percent chance (interest rates) will come down," Symond told Reuters.
"I would certainly be saying 25-50 basis points over the next two to three months," he added.
Symond noted that unemployment was rising, and said the Australian dollar remained at levels that could not be sustained in the long-term.
The Reseve Bank of Australia last cut official interest rates on December 11 by 0.5 percentage points to 6.0 percent.
